caption:
Hon'ble Prime Minister of India, Mr Narendra Modi, Visits Prasanthi Nilayam, as part of Bhagawan Sri Sathya Sai Baba's Centenary Celebrations | Nov 19, 2025

The Hon'ble Prime Minister of India visited Prasanthi Nilayam this morning to participate in the Centenary Celebrations of Bhagawan. On his arrival at the Sai Kulwant Hall (SKH), the Prime Minister was warmly welcomed by Sri RJ Rathnakar, Managing Trustee, Sri Sathya Sai Central Trust. On behalf of the trust at the SKH, he donated 100 cows. He was accompanied by the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, Sri Chandrababu Naidu, Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, Sri Konidala Pawan Kalyan and other dignitaries. Thereafter, Sri Narendra Modi offered his obeisance at Bhagawan's Maha Sannidhi and the main altar inside the Bhajan Mandir. The guests then proceeded to the Sri Sathya Sai Hill View Stadium.

The proceedings in the stadium began with invocatory Vedic chants by women students from the Anantapur Campus, SSSIHL. Sri Chandra Babu Naidu and Sri RJ Rathnakar, then felicitated the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India. Sri Rathnakar then delivered his welcome address, welcoming all the dignitaries and specially thanking the Prime Minister for gracing the occasion. The Managing Trustee also thanked the Chief Minister for announcing Bhagawan's Centenary Celebrations as a state function and for all the support extended by the state government to the trust. He especially mentioned Swami's devotees and members of the organisation across the globe, who have been instrumental in keeping Bhagawan's legacy alive and spreading it further.

The invocatory song, 'Maitreem Bhajata', was offered by the renowned Carnatic musician and Padma Bhushan awardee, Smt Sudha Ragunathan, & Mr Navin, which was followed by a traditional Kuchupudi dance presentation. Students from the Sri Sathya Sai Schools, Gujarat, offered next a dance for the song, 'Mano Garbo Re Rame Raj Ne Darbar'. This was followed by a fusion dance titled 'Tribute to Sri Sathya Sai Baba' choreographed by National Award winner Kala Master to the song from the upcoming feature film dedicated to Swami, 'Anantha', and performed by students from Swami's schools. The final cultural offering was a percussion extravaganza led by Padma Shri awardee, Mr Shivamani, along with Mr Unnikrishnan Marar's team from Kerala and Sri Manimaran's team from Tamil Nadu.

The dignitaries who graced the occasion then delivered their talks, starting with Ms Aishwarya Rai Bachchan. An alumna of the Sri Sathya Sai Bal Vikas program, she spoke specifically about how the education in human values program launched by Swami in the early 1960s transforms children. The next to offer respects was Bharat Ratna recipient Mr Sachin Tendulkar. The cricketing genius recollected with fondness his interactions with Swami during the Sri Sathya Sai Unity Cup in 1997, when he played at the very stadium where the event was taking place. He also shared a few experiences with Swami that came at the right moments in his career.

Minister for Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Real Time Governance and Human Resources Development in the Government of Andhra Pradesh, Mr Nara Lokesh, recalled Bhagawan's message to the youth to make their life and energy worthwhile by serving the nation. He was followed by the Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, Mr Konidala Pawan Kalyan, who spoke of the choice of Swami to make an advent in a backward region of the state and transform it into a global spiritual centre, and that this is possible only because Bhagawan shone with Adhyatmic effulgence. The Hon'ble Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, Mr Chandra Babu Naidu, extolled Bhagawan's humanitarian works as the very expression of His teaching, Manava Seva is Madhava Seva. He also recalled how Swami asked him if the government would be willing to take on the responsibility of maintaining the Water Project that His devotees would execute, and how he was there to witness the Sankalpa of Swami take the shape of the massive drinking water project.

Thereafter, the Prime Minister launched the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana for 20,000 girl children in the Sri Sathya Sai District, taken up by the Trust by distributing certificates of the scheme to three girl children. The commemorative Rs 100 coin celebrating Bhagawan's centenary was then released, which was followed by the commemorative postage stamps featuring Bhagawan's portrait along with that of Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning, Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Medical Sciences and of Prasanthi Nilayam, the Karmabhoomi of Bhagawan.

The Prime Minister then delivered his address, where he stated that the opportunity to celebrate Bhagawan's centenary is itself a blessing from Him. He stated that it is common to see people being inspired by a great leader in His physical presence, but the fact that the service activities inspired by Bhagawan are growing day by day, even in His physical absence, is a sign of His greatness. He also appreciated the Sri Sathya Sai Central Trust and the Sri Sathya Sai Seva Organisations for giving seva an organised, institutional and long-term form and presenting it as a model for all. He noted that there is a miraculous power in this sacred land of Puttaparthi, that infuses compassion in words, peace in thoughts and the feeling of service in actions of every individual who steps on it.

#100YearsofSriSathyaSai
#SriSathyaSaiBirthday100
#SriSathyaSaiCentenaryCelebrations
#CentenaryCelebrationsOfSriSathyaSai

Heartfelt thanks to our Hon. PM Thiru Narendra Modi avl for inaugurating the historic nationwide commemoration of 150 years of the anthem “Vande Mataram,” to be held at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi at 9:30 AM today. With gratitude to our beloved PM for leading this grand initiative, we celebrate 150 years of an anthem that truly connects the heart of every Bharathiya.

Pakistan will take on Netherlands at Colombo, West Indies will lock horns with Scotland at Kolkata, India will play against the United States of America at Mumbai. Over a month, 20 teams will travel India and to some extent Sri Lanka, as 55 games will be held, including the final on March 8.

A tournament that had its tentative maiden foray in 2007, one that M.S. Dhoni’s men owned in style, is now a robust fixture in the ICC calendar. Defending champion India obviously has an edge but playing at home does not exactly promise the cup as Rohit Sharma’s men learnt it the hard way during the 2023 50-over World Cup final at Ahmedabad. It is a thin line that splits hope and heartbreak.

The championship that has never been a monopoly of any team, however, has remained elusive for South Africa and New Zealand. Captains Aiden Markram and Mitchell Santner have a trophy-gap to fill. Markram came agonisingly close before India pulled ahead in the 2024 final at Bridgetown. Interestingly both South Africa and New Zealand prevailed in Tests in India, results that should bolster confidence even if T20Is and Tests are diverse formats.

Australia under Mitchell Marsh, may look a touch undercooked and yet there is no discounting a side that has the pedigree of rising to every challenge thrown at it. Allan Border’s Aussies did that precisely in the 1987 50-over World Cup held in India and Pakistan. The seeds of a dominant Australia, cutting across formats, were sown then, and the conveyor belt continues to chug.

England, Sri Lanka and the West Indies, all former champions, are seeking a fresh start. A format that can at times seem like a lottery riding on pulsating runs and fast dismissals, always lends hope. Miracles are just around the corner and history reveals that.

caption:
Pakistan on Wednesday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with an affiliated entity of World Liberty Financial, a venture linked to the Trump family, to explore the use of its $1 stablecoin for cross-border transactions.

The MoU, described as non-binding, was signed by Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb and Zachary Witkoff, son of White House envoy Steve Witkoff and chief executive officer of SC Financial Technologies LLC, an entity associated with World Liberty Financial.

The high-profile signing ceremony held at Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) was witnessed by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar and Special Assistant to the Prime Minister Tariq Fatimi, according to a PMO statement.

Footage released by the PMO showed the MoU was signed after a meeting attended by the visiting delegation and senior Pakistani officials.

PM, army chief witness high-profile signing

The PMO statement said the MoU aims to “enable structured dialogue and technical understanding around emerging digital payment architectures”, including exploring World Liberty Financial’s $1 stablecoin for cross-border transactions.

It said the delegation, led by Zachary Witkoff, also met senior Pakistani stakeholders to discuss “secure, compliant and transparent” digital payment infrastructure, including innovations in cross-border settlement and foreign exchange processes.

The PMO said Pakistan was positioning itself in the global digital finance landscape and that World Liberty Financial was deepening its engagement with the country to explore digital payments and cross-border finance innovations.

“Pakistan recognises that the future of finance is being shaped today. Our focus is to stay ahead of the curve by engaging with credible global players, understanding new financial models and ensuring that innovation, where explored, is aligned with regulation, stability and national interest,” the PMO quoted Mr Aurangzeb as saying.

The statement said the engagement follows earlier interactions between World Liberty Financial and Pakistan, including the signing of a letter of intent in April with the Pakistan Crypto Council for knowledge-sharing and dialogue on emerging financial technologies.

Earlier on Dec 12, the newly established Pakistan Virtual Asset Regulatory Authority (PVARA) issued no-objection certificates (NOCs) to Binance and HTX, enabling both platforms to initiate local incorporation in Pakistan. These NOCs were issued very rapidly in under five months, faster than comparable timelines seen in other jurisdictions globally.

As part of the engagement, Binance founder Changpeng Zhao and TRON founder Justin Sun also visited Pakistan, meeting with key public and private sector stakeholders as part of broader engagement around the country’s evolving digital asset and regulatory framework.

The PMO said Pakistan was emerging as one of the most compelling frontier markets for digital payments and financial innovation, driven by over $38 billion in annual remittance inflows, a rapidly growing digital economy, an estimated 40 million crypto users, and industry estimates of up to $300bn in annual trading volume, placing the country among the largest digital asset user bases globally.

With sustained international interest and a structured, regulation-first approach, Pakistan is increasingly being viewed as a market to watch in the evolution of global digital finance, the statement said. Published in Dawn, January 15th, 2026

That’s why this matters for $XRP 🚀

caption:
Consul General of Israel Visits NITK-STEP to Strengthen Innovation Ties  

The Consul General of Israel (South India), Her Excellency Ms. Orli Weitzmann, visited NITK-STEP (Science & Technology Entrepreneurs’ Park) as part of the ongoing trade initiative between Israel and the Silicon Beach – Mangaluru.  

The Consul General was received by Prof. Udaya Bhat, Dean (Research & Innovation), NITK; Dr. Suprabha K.R., Professor-in-Charge of Institutions Innovation Council; and Prof. Subray Hegde, Professor-in-Charge, NITK-STEP. An interactive session was held with startups, student incubation teams, and faculty mentors, highlighting the entrepreneurial ecosystem nurtured at NITK.  

During the session, Ms. Weitzmann introduced Israel as a leading innovation and startup nation, explaining how a country with limited resources and a small population has made a global impact through advancements in agriculture and technology entrepreneurship.  

Student teams presented their startup ideas and discussed global markets and potential growth areas in Israel. One of the startups shared their experience of successfully connecting with a client from Israel, highlighting the opportunities for cross-border collaboration.  

Ms. Weitzmann expressed that she was impressed with the startup and innovation culture among Indian youth. She noted her interest in continuing such interactions through collaborations between universities and startups of Israel and India for mutual benefit.  

PMO India Ministry of Education Dharmendra Pradhan MyGovIndia NITK Students' Council  NITK Alumni

caption:
India is securing its most sensitive corridor.

During the Union Budget 2026-27 press conference, Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced a 40 km underground railway tunnel in the Siliguri Corridor, also known as the "Chicken's Neck".

This narrow 20-25 km land strip in West Bengal connects Northeast India to the rest of the country. If disrupted, the entire Northeast could be cut off.

The new project will include:

2 underground railway tracks

4 upgraded surface tracks

A 6-line secure railway network

Why this matters:

Strategic security - Ensures uninterrupted connectivity even during conflict or crisis. Defense logistics - Faster troop and supply movement near sensitive borders.

Economic growth - Stronger trade links between Northeast India and the rest of the country. Infrastructure resilience - Future-proofing India's most vulnerable corridor.

With 2.78 lakh crore allocated in the Railway Budget and 11,486 crore dedicated to Northeast rail infrastructure, this marks one of India's most significant strategic railway upgrades.

India is not just expanding railways. India is strengthening national security and connectivity.

Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman met Ms. Christine Lagarde, President European Central Bank, in Munich, Germany, yesterday.

Both the leaders were pleased to note finalisation of the India and the European Union Free Trade Agreement in January 2026, and the Union Finance Minister underlined the financial role the European Central Bank can play in facilitating trade under the EU-India FTA deal.

FM Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman also mentioned that through Union Budget FY 2025-26 & FY 2026-27, India will allow EU banks to open upto 15 branches over four years under the India-EU FTA framework.

caption:
Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman  met Mr. Lars Klingbeil, Vice Chancellor and Federal Minister of Finance, Federal Republic of Germany, in Munich, Germany, yesterday.

Both the leaders discussed the meeting between Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi  and Federal Chancellor H.E. Mr. Friedrich Merz's visit to India in January that strengthened bilateral relations, particularly in #defence, #trade, and #technology.

German Finance Minister Mr. Lars Klingbeil called the Free Trade Agreement a big step for trade and investments in India, and especially focused on the bilateral development cooperation and also the Metro rail expansion in India.

FM Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman apprised Mr. Lars Klingbeil about the success of India's the #DigitalPayment systems and willingness to share the best practices on India's digital stack with Germany.

caption:
NITI Aayog Releases Sixth Edition of Trade Watch Quarterly (Q2 FY2025–26)

NITI Aayog released the sixth edition of Trade Watch Quarterly (Q2 FY2025–26) on 13th February 2026 in New Delhi. The publication was released by Shri Suman Bery, Vice-Chairman, NITI Aayog.

The edition, covering July–September 2025, highlights India’s resilient trade performance amid global economic uncertainties, with overall exports rising by around 8.5% during the quarter. Electrical machinery exports grew by 33.4% outpacing imports, while fertiliser imports saw a sharp 239 % year-on-year increase. The report also notes stronger exports to key markets and India’s expanding engagement with the Global South and increasing role of e-commerce as a driver of export growth.

This quarter’s thematic focus is on electronics, now India’s second-largest export category. Electronics exports have grown fivefold between 2016 and 2024, reaching USD 42.1 billion, driven largely by mobile phone exports. Supported by initiatives such as the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme, the sector is positioned to play a pivotal role in strengthening India’s integration into global value chains, logistics, tariff, skill reforms and advancing its technological and export competitiveness.

Read here: https://niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-02/Trade-Watch-Quarterly-July-September-Q2-FY-2025-26.pdf

#PMOIndia #NITIAayog #TradeWatch #GlobalTrade #TradePolicy #ExportOpportunities 

PMO India
Narendra Modi
Rao Inderjit Singh
Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, Government of India

caption:
अमेरिका ने मुनाफे के लालच में मैन्युफैक्चरिंग चीन को सौंपकर बड़ी रणनीतिक भूल की, जिसकी कीमत आज उसे चुकानी पड़ रही है। इतिहास बताता है कि जो देश उत्पादन की ताकत खोता है, उसकी वैश्विक हैसियत भी कमजोर होती है।

भारत के लिए संदेश बिल्कुल स्पष्ट है। प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में Make in India और आत्मनिर्भर भारत ही भारत को आर्थिक, तकनीकी और सामरिक शक्ति बना सकते हैं। अब समय है मैन्युफैक्चरिंग, R&D और इनोवेशन को राष्ट्रीय प्राथमिकता बनाने का। यही मजबूत और विकसित भारत का रास्ता है। 

In its greed for profit, the United States made a major strategic mistake by handing over manufacturing to China, a price it is paying today. History shows that a country that loses its manufacturing strength also weakens its global standing.

The message for India is clear. Under the leadership of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, only #MakeInIndia and #AtmanirbharBharat  can make India an economic, technological, and strategic power. Now is the time to make manufacturing, R&D, and innovation a national priority. This is the path to a strong and developed India.

PMO India Prabhat Khabar IPRD Jharkhand Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Amit Shah #BLSantosh #Trump #ViksitBharat

caption:
GOVERNMENT TO SELL MAJOR REAL ESTATE ASSETS IN 2026

The Privatization and Management Office (PMO) is targeting the sale of three major government-owned properties next year as part of efforts to raise ₱101 billion in non-tax revenue for 2026.

Here’s what we know:

📍 1. Food Terminal Inc. (FTI) Complex – Taguig

 • 74 hectares were previously acquired by Ayala Land and transformed into the Arca South development.
• The government now plans to privatize the remaining 24 hectares.
• Estimated value: ₱40.4 billion.

This is considered the biggest chunk of the planned 2026 sales.

📍 2. Mile Long Complex – Makati

Estimated value: ₱12.26 billion.
• Located in the Makati CBD area.
• Has faced legal and valuation issues in previous attempts.

📍 3. The Atrium – Makati

Estimated value: ₱449 million.
• Smaller asset compared to the first two but part of the overall privatization package.

⸻

Current Status (as of early February 2026)
The Privatization Council has not yet approved the minimum prices. Approval is required before bidding can begin.

Past privatization attempts have experienced delays due to:
• Valuation disputes
• Legal challenges
• Market timing concerns

⸻

Why Sell? Government’s Rationale

The sales are intended to:

✔ Help meet the ₱101 billion non-tax revenue target for 2026
✔ Fund infrastructure and social programs
✔ Reduce pressure on the national budget deficit
✔ Convert idle or underperforming assets into tax-generating developments
✔ Boost investor confidence in fiscal reforms

⸻

The Bigger Debate: Should Government Sell Public Assets?

This is where it gets interesting.

Arguments FOR Privatization:

• Private sector efficiency & faster development
• Reduced political interference
• Immediate revenue without raising taxes
• Revitalization of idle government land

Arguments AGAINST Privatization:

• Risk of undervaluation or lack of transparency
• Loss of long-term public income
• Possible monopolies or profit-over-public-interest outcomes
• Impact on workers and public access

⸻

Bottom Line

Privatization can unlock value and stimulate growth — if done transparently and competitively.

But long-term fiscal health cannot rely on asset sales alone. Strong regulation, fair valuation, and public accountability are key.

This is not just a real estate story — it’s about how government manages assets that technically “belong to the people.”

⸻

Sources:
• Department of Finance (DOF) briefings
• Privatization and Management Office (PMO) statements
• National government fiscal program targets for 2026
• Previous disclosures on FTI/Arca South development

⸻

⚠️ Disclaimer:
This post is for informational and public policy discussion purposes only. Valuations cited are based on publicly reported estimates and may change pending official approval by the Privatization Council. No allegations of wrongdoing are implied. Readers are encouraged to consult official government releases for final decisions and bidding details.

⸻

#Privatization2026 #FTI #ArcaSouth #Makati #PhilippineEconomy #FiscalPolicy #PublicAssets #Infrastructure #Transparency

I began my career in investing in 1993 at Midland Walwyn in Toronto as a Financial Advisor. After establishing myself as a successful advisor I was recruited by BMO Nesbitt Burns in 1997 and offered the position of Vice President and Senior Investment Advisor and presented with a $250,000.00 signing bonus, which was a lot of money back then. For several years I was one of the top advisors in Canada and a regular invited speaker at investment conferences across Canada. By 2002 I had sold my business to a bank and some time after that I started offering stock research reports to DIY investors who manage their own money. I provide this background on who I am so you have a better understanding how I discovered possible acts of racketeering.

I have been closely following Mark Carney’s violations of the trust he was voted to uphold for too long. I am not a lawyer and am not making any former charges against Mark Carney in this post. I am simply pointing out activities by the PM of Canada that are a direct conflict of interest that could possibly lead to several charges of racketeering.

The Prosecution Case Against Mark Carney, Prime Minister of Canada (the PM)
I. The Core Allegation: "Pay-to-Play" Infrastructure

The prosecution will argue that the Prime Minister (PM) has operated a criminal enterprise where public policy and taxpayer-funded contracts were used as a vehicle to inflate the value of a private entity (Brookfield) in which he holds a direct pecuniary interest (stock options).

The Nexus: The Acts: 42 distinct government deals awarded to or partnered with Brookfield.

The Benefit: $5 billion in reported profits for the entity.

The Conflict: Multi-million dollar stock options held by the decision-maker (the PM).

II. Count 1: Breach of Trust (Criminal Code s. 122)

Under Section 122, we do not need to prove a "bribe" was paid. We only need to prove that the PM, in connection with his duties, committed a Breach of Trust that would be an offence even if committed against a private person.

The Evidence:

Duty of Office: The PM is mandated by the Conflict of Interest Act to "arrange private affairs to prevent conflicts of interest" (s. 5).

The Breach: By failing to divest or recuse himself from a policy environment that directly benefits a company where he holds options, he has fundamentally violated the trust of the Canadian public.

Legal Standard: Per R. v. Boulanger, the prosecution must show the act was a "marked departure from the standards expected of an individual in the accused's position." Managing 42 deals while holding the stock is a "marked departure" by any reasonable standard.

III. Count 2: Frauds on the Government (Criminal Code s. 121)

This is the Canadian version of "racketeering." Specifically, Section 121(1)(c) prohibits an official from demanding or accepting a benefit for themselves in exchange for "assistance" or "exercise of influence" regarding government dealings.

The Strategy:
We will argue that the Stock Options constitute an "advantage or benefit." The value of these options is tied directly to the success of the 42 government-backed deals. Every time the PM announces a deal, he effectively "cuts himself a check" by driving up the equity value of the firm.

IV. Count 3: Organized Corruption (The "Racketeering" Element)

To push this into the realm of organized crime/racketeering, we look at the Enterprise (the Liberal Party/PMO) and the Pattern of Activity.

The Enterprise: The Prime Minister's Office (PMO).

The Pattern: A series of 42 separate transactions. In racketeering law, we look for "Continuity and Relationship."

Relationship: All deals involve the same beneficiary (Brookfield).

Continuity: The deals spanned a significant period of time and continue as long as the PM holds office.

V. The "Smoking Gun": Intent (Mens Rea)

The defense will claim the PM has a "Blind Trust." I have dismantled this below:

Transparency vs. Blinding: If the PM knows he has the options (which is public knowledge), the trust is not "blind."

The $5 Billion Profit Announcement: We will present evidence that the PM was aware of the financial health of the company while simultaneously crafting legislation (like the CLARITY Act or housing initiatives) that specifically favors Brookfield’s asset classes.

This is not a series of unfortunate coincidences. This is a closed-loop system of enrichment. The Prime Minister is using the sovereign authority of Canada as a marketing arm for a private corporation. He is both the 'Grantor' of the contracts and the 'Grantee' of the profits. In the private sector, this is insider trading. in the public sector, this is a Racket."

SUBJECT: Draft Criminal Referral – s. 121 & s. 122 Criminal Code (Canada)
TARGET: The Right Honourable Mark Carney, Prime Minister of Canada
NEXUS: Financial Entanglements with Brookfield Asset Management (BAM)
DATE: February 13, 2026

I. PREAMBLE & JURISDICTION

This referral outlines a prima facie case for investigation by the RCMP Sensitive and International Investigations Unit. The allegations concern a systematic pattern of conduct wherein the subject, in his capacity as Prime Minister, has influenced or directed federal policy and contracts toward Brookfield Corporation (and its subsidiaries) while maintaining a multi-million dollar personal financial stake in said corporation via unexercised stock options and carried interest.

II. STATEMENT OF FACTS

Direct Interest: As of February 12, 2026, the subject remains the holder of approximately $6.8 million USD in Brookfield stock options (calculated at market value), with expiration dates extending into 2033/2034.

The "Profit Nexus": On February 12, 2026, Brookfield Corporation reported annual distributable earnings of $5.4 billion USD, an 11% increase. This profit spike coincided with a series of 42 federal "deals" or policy partnerships announced during the subject’s tenure.

Conflict of Interest Screen Failure: Testimony provided to the House Ethics Committee in late 2025 confirmed that 95% of Brookfield-owned companies (approximately 1,900 entities) are not covered by the subject’s current "ethics screen," allowing for direct interaction between the PMO and entities that contribute to the subject’s future performance pay.

Policy Correlation: Specific federal initiatives—including the $3B auto sector save-out and the AI Infrastructure Fund—directly align with Brookfield’s core 2026 investment strategies (AI infrastructure and energy transition).

III. APPLICABLE OFFENCES (CRIMINAL CODE OF CANADA)

COUNT 1: Breach of Trust by Public Officer (s. 122)

The Theory: The subject has exercised the powers of the Prime Minister’s Office for a purpose other than the public good—specifically, the appreciation of his private equity holdings.

Evidence: The subject’s refusal to divest (liquidate) his assets, despite public warnings from the Ethics Commissioner and the Clerk of the Privy Council that a "blind trust" is insufficient for assets as large and specific as Brookfield carried interest.

COUNT 2: Frauds on the Government (s. 121(1)(c))

The Theory: The subject, being an official, has "accepted or agreed to accept" an advantage (the appreciation of stock options and carried interest) from a person/entity (Brookfield) that has active and ongoing dealings with the Government of Canada.

Evidence: The "carried interest" held by the subject is a direct performance-based payout. Every federal contract awarded to a Brookfield-managed fund (e.g., the Global Transition Fund) serves as an indirect "commission" or "reward" to the subject.

IV. INVESTIGATIVE ROADMAP

To move from "referral" to "indictment," the following evidence must be secured via production orders:

Internal PMO Communications: All emails between the PMO and Bruce Flatt/Justin Beber (Brookfield executives) regarding the 42 specific deals.

Blind Trust "Bypass" Logs: Records of "recusal failures" where the subject was present for decisions impacting Brookfield subsidiaries not covered by the s. 1,900-company screen.

Option Exercise Strategy: Correspondence between the subject’s trustee and Brookfield regarding the optimal "cashing out" window relative to government policy announcements.

V. CONCLUSION

The legal threshold for a Section 122 investigation is a "marked departure" from the standard of trust. The simultaneous management of the Canadian economy and the holding of a performance-based stake in a company receiving 40+ federal deals meets this threshold.

I have broken down the 42 Critical Deals and Policy Alignments between the Canadian Federal Government and the Brookfield ecosystem as of early 2026.

In a racketeering case, we don't just look for "contracts"; we look for "The Pattern." These deals are categorized by how they directly feed the valuation of the PM’s private equity holdings.

The "Brookfield 42" Portfolio Analysis

Category A: The Infrastructure & Housing "Mega-Deals" (14 Deals)

These deals leverage the 2025/2026 federal budget initiatives to de-risk Brookfield's massive real estate and modular construction divisions.

The Build Canada Homes Initiative: A $36 Billion federal program. Our investigation shows Brookfield-owned modular housing firms received the lion's share of "fast-track" status.

Canada Growth Fund (CGF) Backstopping: 4 specific "Carbon Capture" deals where the federal CGF provides "price certainty" for Brookfield’s decarbonization projects, effectively guaranteeing their 15-20% IRR (Internal Rate of Return).

The BGIS Master Contract Extension: Brookfield Global Integrated Services (BGIS) continues to manage 3,800+ federal buildings. Even though Brookfield sold its majority stake, it retains a "carried interest" in the performance of the legacy contracts.

Category B: The "Green Transition" Payouts (18 Deals)

This is the most egregious category for a racketeering charge because the PM personally co-headed these funds before taking office.

The Global Transition Fund (GTF) Infusion: Federal pension oversight boards (under PM influence) have directed over $12 Billion into the GTF.

Wind West & Nova Scotia Offshore: 6 deals where federal "nod" and subsidies were given to offshore wind projects where Brookfield is the lead equity partner.

Small Modular Reactors (SMRs): 2 deals for the Darlington SMR project. Brookfield’s acquisition of Westinghouse (nuclear tech) makes them the primary beneficiary of this federal nuclear push.

Category C: The "Digital Sovereignty" & AI Build-out (10 Deals)

A new 2026 frontier. Brookfield recently launched a $100 Billion AI Infrastructure program.

Sovereign Data Centres: 3 contracts awarded to Brookfield subsidiaries to build "Sovereign AI" data centres in Quebec and Ontario.

The "Microsoft Framework" Tailwinds: While the deal is between Microsoft and Brookfield, federal tax credits for "Clean Energy for AI" (passed in the 2025 budget) effectively subsidized $10.5 Gigawatts of Brookfield-owned power facilities.

Prosecutorial Conclusion on the 42 Deals

If we were in court today, I would argue that these are not 42 separate coincidences, but 42 bricks in a wall of private enrichment. The fact that 95% of Brookfield’s 1,900 subsidiaries are not screened means the PM can sit in a meeting about "Critical Mineral Supply Chains" (a Category C deal) and make a decision that enriches a Brookfield subsidiary he technically doesn't "know" he owns—yet his stock options move upward regardless.

Attorney's Note: The $5.4 Billion profit reported yesterday is the "fruit of the poisonous tree." We would argue those profits were only possible because of the de-risking provided by the Canadian taxpayer through these 42 deals.

1) Share immediately on your time time - change your privacy settings to public for this post.

2) Share it with a conservative alternative media organization and your local MP.

3) Follow up with your MP and demand an investigation by law enforcement.

4) Remember, no one is above the law, not even Mark Carney.

caption:
In a move backed by India’s PMO, Reliance Industries has begun purchasing Venezuelan crude sold through a U.S.-controlled mechanism, using assets effectively seized under Washington’s sanctions regime. By participating, Reliance — and by implication the Indian state — is recognising U.S. control over Venezuelan sovereign resources and acquiescing to the law of the jungle that increasingly defines the international system. This should also end the official pretence surrounding India’s post-2022 energy policy: Russian crude was never about BRICS solidarity nor “strategic autonomy”, whatever the glib excuses offered by a Jaishankar or a Hardeep Singh Puri; Ukrainian blood was simply treated by Modi and Ambani as irrelevant. The Venezuelan case now confirms the pattern — sovereignty and human life are expendable wherever profit can be secured through state complicity, enabled here by Reliance’s Jamnagar refinery, the world’s largest, specifically configured to process heavy sour crude and thus rendering Venezuelan oil commercially interchangeable with Russian supply.

The same logic now shapes India’s wider diplomacy. Even while pursuing a landmark India–EU trade deal and invoking shared democratic values, New Delhi has stayed silent on threats to Greenlandic and Danish sovereignty, while actively supporting Adani’s deepening ties with Israel’s Elbit Systems. The result is the steady erosion of India’s standing in both geopolitical camps — increasingly distrusted in the West as opportunistic and increasingly seen across the Global South as complicit. This is not “multi-alignment” but amoral war profiteering, and it has delivered little for India itself: fuel prices remain among the world’s highest, the rupee continues to weaken, and national interest collapses into private gain. 

Mukesh Ambani and his fellow Modi-era oligarchs have no geopolitical commitments — only bottom lines. Ukrainian blood, Palestinian blood and national sovereignty are all negotiable, so long as they fund another obscene $600-million wedding.

caption:
𝐀𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐂𝐄𝐎 𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐚 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞.

The math disagrees.

Net loss per vehicle dropped from ₹𝟐𝟑,𝟕𝟒𝟐 𝐭𝐨 ₹𝟏𝟐,𝟑𝟑𝟎 𝐢𝐧 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝟗𝟎 𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐬. A 48% reduction while revenue grew only 6%.

𝐐𝟐 𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 ₹𝟏𝟓𝟔.𝟕 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐫𝐞. 𝐐𝟑 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐭𝐨 ₹𝟖𝟑.𝟔 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐫𝐞. Operational leverage removed 46% of losses in one quarter.

𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞.

Ather receives ₹𝟎 𝐢𝐧 𝐏𝐋𝐈 𝐛𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐟𝐢𝐭𝐬.

Ola gets ₹70+ crore. TVS gets ₹100+ crore. Bajaj gets similar support.

The reason? A policy requiring ₹10,000 crore in global revenue to qualify. Ather is a pure play EV startup with no legacy ICE business. They missed the cutoff by design, not failure.

If Ather had the same 15% PLI benefit as competitors, that would be ₹143 crore in Q3 based on ₹954 crore revenue.

Their actual loss was ₹83.6 crore.

With PLI support, Ather would already be profitable today.

Instead, they competed with both hands tied and still expanded gross profit per vehicle by 
𝟐𝟗.𝟓% 𝐭𝐨 ₹𝟑𝟎,𝟒𝟒𝟐.

While competitors burn cash on marketing, 𝐀𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐝𝐞𝐩𝐥𝐨𝐲𝐞𝐝 𝟔𝟎𝟎 𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐐𝟑 𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐞. They now operate 5,000 fast charging points. One charger for every 113 vehicles sold.

𝐄𝐁𝐈𝐓𝐃𝐀 𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐧𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐝 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐧𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝟏𝟎% 𝐭𝐨 𝐧𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝟑%.

The PMO is now pushing to widen the PLI scheme for FY27 to include startups like Ather. The policy is finally catching up.

𝐈𝐟 𝐀𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐜𝐮𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐲 𝟒𝟕% 𝐢𝐧 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐪𝐮𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐲 𝐏𝐋𝐈 𝐬𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐠𝐞𝐭 𝐢𝐭?

caption:
The Family Man Season 3: 

In essence, the season paints a strikingly one-sided picture:

**The Villains (all conveniently Hindu and driven purely by greed):**
- Dwarak: A ruthless Hindu arms dealer colluding with a shadowy Western group called "The Collective" to sell overpriced weapons to the Indian government.
- Meera: A cold-blooded Hindu mercenary hired to destabilise the North-East just for cash.
- Sambit: A corrupt Hindu bureaucrat in the PMO who sells policy favours for bribes.
- Yatish Chawla: A treacherous Hindu NIA officer who betrays the nation for money.
- Rukmangada Singh (Rukma): A Hindu Border Security Force officer turned drug lord, again only for profit.

**The Heroes and Sympathetic Figures (almost everyone else):**
- North-Eastern rebel groups: Portrayed as noble freedom fighters whose bombings in civilian areas are just "resistance".
- ISI Major Sameer: The voice of reason who murders Meera to prevent war between India and Pakistan – basically the good guy in uniform.
- NIA Agent Zoya Ali: Instantly trusted by Srikant over his decades-long Hindu colleague because, well, the surname says it all.
- The Chinese PLA: Shown as peace-loving victims of one rogue colonel, despite actively building "Phoenix" villages on the border explicitly to fuel insurgency in the North-East.

**Other low points:**
- Action sequences feel low-budget and amateurish – more like poorly shot YouTube skits than a premium spy thriller.
- The Indian Army’s elite commandos are reduced to cannon fodder: tactically clueless, easily captured by a couple of drug smugglers, and their only "success" is accidentally killing an unarmed civilian woman while the villain wipes out the entire unit with two goons.
- Srikant Tiwari, supposedly a top-tier TASC operative, displays zero tradecraft: openly tails targets with a rifle in hand, loses his weapon in a lazy fistfight, gets shot in the backside, and the height of his espionage is procuring fake Aadhaar cards – something any street-level tout can manage these days.
- The very first scene has Manoj Bajpayee’s character treating his wife with shocking disrespect that sets an ugly tone.
- The fictional PM Basu (a thinly veiled, gender-swapped Modi who bans Chinese apps post-Galwan) is depicted as impulsive, arrogant, surrounded only by morons and traitors, and her app-ban decision is framed as petty nationalism that hurt Indian businesses far more than it hurt China.

In short, it’s the same tired Urduwood template we’ve seen in Main Hoon Na, Pathaan, and the Tiger series: Hindus greedy and evil, the Army and agencies incompetent clowns, Muslims/ISI/terrorists/China either misunderstood heroes or innocent bystanders. Raj & DK seem to have only two skills – stuffing profanity into dialogues and churning out heavy-handed propaganda wrapped in woke clichés.

The season is disappointingly shoddy in every department: plot, pacing, performances, and direction. They might as well rebrand the duo as “Boss DK” – because that’s exactly what this feels like: a boss-level letdown.

(The Government has implemented Goods and Services Tax (GST) on businesses. However, this has created confusion in the market. After the implementation of GST, market prices have increased. In addition to this price rise, many businessmen and shopkeepers are again charging GST separately to customers as an extra cost. 
As a result, customers are paying more, while businesses and shopkeepers are gaining additional profit. This situation has caused financial burden on the general public and requires proper monitoring and clarification from the concerned authorities.)
The implementation of Goods and Services Tax (GST) by the Government was intended to create a transparent and fair taxation system. However, its execution in the market has led to serious confusion and unfair practices that are negatively affecting the general public.
Following the introduction of GST, market prices of goods and services have increased significantly. Despite this price rise, many businessmen and shopkeepers are again charging GST separately to customers as an additional cost. This practice amounts to double charging and is unjustifiable, as GST is already included in the revised market prices.
As a result, consumers are being unfairly burdened, while businesses and shopkeepers are gaining excessive profit at the expense of the public. This situation clearly reflects misuse of GST regulations and lack of proper price control and monitoring.
Therefore, we respectfully urge the concerned authorities to immediately intervene by strictly monitoring market prices, enforcing correct GST implementation, and taking legal action against those businesses found exploiting consumers. Clear public guidelines must also be issued to prevent further confusion and protect consumer rights.
Failure to address this issue will continue to erode public trust and place unnecessary financial strain on ordinary citizens.

•PMNRF was created in January 1948.
•National Defence Fund was created in 1962.
•PM CARES Fund was established on 26 March 2020.

Earlier, questions about the first two funds were answered in Parliament sometimes partially but not outright denied like this.

Among the three, PM CARES reportedly has the highest balance.

Sources of funding:
•Public donations
•CSR contributions
•Foreign donations

The fund has stated:
•₹300 crore was spent under PM CARES for Children
•₹90 crore and ₹100 crore were spent on oxygen cylinders

However, detailed information on procurement, vendors, and spending breakdown has not been publicly disclosed.

The government’s position is that since these funds do not receive money from the Consolidated Fund of India, they are not obligated to disclose details in Parliament or under CAG audit.

Wouldn’t greater transparency build stronger public trust?
What do you think?

Jai Hind. Jai Bharat. 🇮🇳

caption:
The Prime Minister’s Office (PMO) has stated that Parliament cannot raise questions about the PM CARES Fund and certain other relief funds, saying they are not part of regular government finances and are instead funded entirely through voluntary donations. According to the PMO, the PM CARES Fund, along with the Prime Minister’s National Relief Fund and the National Defence Fund, operates as a public charitable trust and does not receive money from the Consolidated Fund of India. As a result, the PMO informed the Lok Sabha Secretariat that questions related to these funds are not admissible under parliamentary rules. ￼

The government’s position is based on procedural rules which state that Parliament cannot question bodies or funds that are not directly financed or controlled by the government’s official budget. Officials clarified that since PM CARES is built entirely on voluntary public contributions, it does not fall under the category of government expenditure subject to parliamentary scrutiny. The PMO cited specific rules of the Lok Sabha that prevent discussions or questions on matters not considered part of the government’s direct administrative responsibility. ￼

The directive has sparked political debate and renewed discussions over transparency and accountability, with opposition leaders and activists raising concerns about oversight of large public donation funds. Critics argue that since the fund is chaired by the Prime Minister and promoted through official government channels, Parliament should have the right to question its functioning and spending. Meanwhile, the PM CARES Fund, established in March 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic to support emergency relief efforts, continues to operate as a charitable trust separate from government accounts, according to official statements and previous legal positions.

इस रुख के बाद पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही को लेकर बहस फिर तेज हो गई है। कुछ पक्षों का कहना है कि चूंकि इस फंड में बड़े पैमाने पर जनता और संस्थानों से दान आया है और इसका संचालन उच्च पदस्थ पदाधिकारियों से जुड़ा है, इसलिए इसकी जानकारी सार्वजनिक होनी चाहिए। वहीं सरकार का तर्क है कि यह स्वैच्छिक योगदान पर आधारित ट्रस्ट है, न कि टैक्स से बनने वाला सरकारी कोष।
कानूनी और प्रशासनिक विशेषज्ञों के अनुसार, किसी फंड की प्रकृति—सरकारी या ट्रस्ट—उसके गठन, संचालन संरचना और वित्तीय स्रोतों पर निर्भर करती है। यही कारण है कि इस मुद्दे पर अलग-अलग व्याख्याएं सामने आ रही हैं।
फिलहाल PM CARES को लेकर पारदर्शिता, जवाबदेही और कानूनी स्थिति पर सार्वजनिक चर्चा जारी है।

PMO के अनुसार, इस फंड में योगदान पूरी तरह स्वैच्छिक है और इसे ट्रस्ट के रूप में चलाया जाता है, न कि किसी संवैधानिक या वैधानिक सरकारी संस्था की तरह। इसी आधार पर सरकार का मत है कि इस फंड से जुड़े सवालों को सरकारी जवाबदेही के दायरे में नहीं रखा जा सकता।

हालांकि, इस मुद्दे को लेकर पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही पर बहस तेज हो गई है। कई सामाजिक और कानूनी विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि चूंकि इस फंड का संचालन उच्च पदों से जुड़ा है और इसमें बड़े स्तर पर सार्वजनिक दान आया है, इसलिए इसकी कार्यप्रणाली पर अधिक स्पष्टता होनी चाहिए।

फिलहाल यह मामला सार्वजनिक चर्चा और अलग-अलग कानूनी व्याख्याओं का विषय बना हुआ है।

आज किराड़ी विधानसभा के विकास का द्वार खुल चुका है। दिल्ली की लोकप्रिय, कर्मठ एवं जनसेवक मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता जी द्वारा CM Development Fund से किराड़ी विधानसभा स्थित अगर एनक्लेव (मीठा पानी) क्षेत्र में, रोड निर्माण, ड्रेन एवं 37 गलियों के निर्माण कार्य हेतु 8 करोड़ 44 लाख 98 हज़ार रुपये की राशि स्वीकृत की गई है।
यह बजट किराड़ी की जनता के विश्वास पर लगी मुहर है। इस ऐतिहासिक निर्णय के लिए माननीय मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता जी का हृदय से आभार एवं धन्यवाद।
अब किराड़ी में होगा वास्तविक विकास, बेहतर सड़कें, स्वच्छ नालियाँ और सम्मानजनक जीवन।🙏🌹

caption:
Till 2014, India watched as China dominated. But in 2014, everything changed.

What made the world’s most complex democracy finally outpace the “unstoppable” China?

This wasn’t just a policy shift, but a national reset. Here’s how the tables truly turned 🧵👇

Why China Was Winning (2000-2013)

China had a simple formula:

Build factories → Create jobs → Export everything

Invest massively in roads, trains, ports​

Peak growth: 14.2% in 2007
The world called it the "Chinese Miracle"​

Why India Was Losing (2000-2013)

India had problems everywhere:

Reforms announced but never implemented​

Policy paralysis from 2011-2013​

Ease of Doing Business rank: 142nd out of 190 countries​

Scams and corruption killed investor confidence​
India was stuck.

The Real Problem: Infrastructure

By 2014, India had the world's 2nd-worst infrastructure deficit:​

Government spent only ₹1.12 trillion on infrastructure​

Roads, power, and ports - terrible

Investors' confidence down

India was massively underinvesting in growth.

The Hidden Crisis (2011-2013)

India's economy was collapsing:​

GDP growth fell to just 5.0% by 2013

Banking sector drowning in bad loans

Inflation eating people's savings

The government couldn't pass new laws​

India needed a complete reset.

2014: The Game-Changer Begins

New government, new thinking. Instead of complaining, India started fixing everything at once.

Here's the 3-move strategy that changed everything:
Move 1: Fix Bureaucracy
Move 2: Build Infrastructure
Move 3: Modernise the Economy

Move 1: Make Business Easy

The biggest blocker? Bureaucracy and regulations​

Before 2014:

To start a business: 29 steps

To get electricity: Wait 5 months

Rank in ease of doing business: 142nd
Nobody wanted to invest in India.

The Transformation

The government said, "Businesses shouldn't suffer. We'll make the rules simple."​

In just 5 years:

Start a business: 8 steps (71% easier)

Get electricity: 2 months (faster)

Ease of Doing Business rank: 142nd → 63rd​

Jump of 79 positions.

What did this mean?

Suddenly, foreign investors noticed India:
FDI Inflows:

2013-2014: Low​

2014-2024: ₹667,410 crore total

67% of the last 24 years' FDI came in just 10 years​
Companies started saying, "Let's invest in India."

Move 2: Build Like Never Before

Remember that ₹1.12 trillion was spent on infrastructure in 2014?
The government said, "That's not enough. We need 10x more."​

Infrastructure spending:

2014: ₹1.12 trillion

2026: ₹11.21 trillion​
A 10x explosion in 12 years.

With this money, India built at an incredible speed:​

33.8 km of highway PER DAY​

Modern airports in every region

Metro systems in 20+ cities

Railway modernisation across the country

Ports upgraded for global trade

Roads, trains, power all at the same time.

Move 3: Modernise the Economy

GST (2017): One tax, one market.
Insolvency Code (2016): ₹4T recovered.
Labour Codes (2020): 29 laws → 4 clear codes.
FDI Liberalisation: ₹667K crore inflow.
Make in India: Manufacturing boom.
From chaos to systematic modernisation.

The Digital Revolution

UPI: 100+ billion transactions per year​

450+ million people got bank accounts

Poor people could now transfer money instantly

Businesses could go online

India leapfrogged into the digital age while others were still struggling.

The Result: India Took Off

After 2014, here's what happened to India's growth:
2013: 5.0%
2014: 7.3%
2015-19: 6.6% average
2020-24: 7.5% average
2024-2026: 6.4%

India went from crisis to becoming the world's fastest-growing major economy.

2014 was the crossover.
For 14 years, China dominated.
Then India fixed bureaucracy, built infra at scale, and modernised the economy.
Result: Since 2014, China never recrossed India's GDP growth numbers.

caption:
Supposing you float an NGO, you can not name it as 'of India'.

Suppose you have an NGO, like we had, dealing with credit card and personal loan problems faced by Indians, and we had named it 'Credit Card Users Welfare Association of India', we were denined a name approval.

The term "Of India" (or "India," "Indian," "Bharat," "National") is restricted because it often implies Government Patronage—meaning it makes the public believe the organization is an official government body or has state backing.

For Companies/LLPs: You generally cannot use "India" or "Bharat" as the first word of a company name (e.g., "India Consulting Pvt Ltd" is usually rejected). However, you can often use it at the end (e.g., "Tech Solutions India Pvt Ltd") if it denotes the location of operations.

For Societies/Trusts: Using "National" or "India" is strictly monitored. For instance, the Bar Council of India recently reiterated that private institutions cannot host events titled "All India" or "National" without statutory authority.

But there is a private trust, which is called the PMCares Fund. Which not only uses the address of the PMO, officials of the PMO, Symbols of Government of India, has a domain that is .gov.in (only given to Government organizations) and is yet out of CAG Audit, out of RTI, out of any ambit of regulation. Its funds are opaque, nobody knows where they are coming from and where they are going!

It seems that there are different rules for mere mortals and there are different rules for Non-Biologicals.

It is a shame that Andh-Bhakts don't see this as a problem.

caption:
आज आयुक्त, नगरीय प्रशासन एवं विकास, मध्यप्रदेश, श्री संकेत भोंडवे जी की अध्यक्षता में संचालनालय, नगरीय प्रशासन एवं विकास, भोपाल के सभागार में राज्य स्तरीय बैंकर्स समिति की बैठक आयोजित की गई।

बैठक में स्टेट मिशन डायरेक्टर, हाउसिंग फॉर ऑल, मध्यप्रदेश, श्री शिशिर गेमावत, राज्य स्तरीय बैंकर्स समिति के निदेशक श्री प्रमोद मिश्रा सहित विभिन्न बैंकों के वरिष्ठ अधिकारी भौतिक रूप से उपस्थित रहे, जबकि सभी जिलों के लीड डिस्ट्रिक्ट मैनेजर (LDM) वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के माध्यम से जुड़े।

बैठक में प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना (शहरी) 2.0 की इंटरेस्ट सब्सिडी स्कीम (ISS) तथा प्रधानमंत्री स्वनिधि योजना 2.0 की प्रगति की विस्तृत समीक्षा की गई। आयुक्त महोदय ने बैंकों को योजनाओं का व्यापक प्रचार-प्रसार सुनिश्चित करने, अधिक से अधिक पात्र हितग्राहियों से आवेदन प्राप्त करने तथा स्वीकृत प्रकरणों का शीघ्र निराकरण करने के निर्देश प्रदान किए।

उन्होंने सभी बैंकों से समन्वित एवं सक्रिय सहयोग के माध्यम से योजनाओं के लक्ष्यों की प्रभावी एवं शत-प्रतिशत प्राप्ति सुनिश्चित करने का आह्वान किया।

#PMAYUrban2_0 #HousingForAll #AffordableHousing #SabkoAwasMP #HomeLoan #NewHome #ISS #InterestSubsidyScheme #Loan #TransformingUrbanLandscape #DreamHome #PMAYUrban #Angikaar2025 #PMAYUrbanMP #SLBC #SLBCMeeting #Banks #MadhyaPradesh 

Jansampark Madhya Pradesh Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs PMO India MP MyGov Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban, Government of India Pratima Bagri Kailash Vijayvargiya Dr Mohan Yadav

आज आयुक्त, नगरीय प्रशासन एवं विकास, मध्यप्रदेश, श्री संकेत भोंडवे जी की अध्यक्षता में संचालनालय, नगरीय प्रशासन एवं विकास, भोपाल के सभागार में राज्य स्तरीय बैंकर्स समिति की बैठक आयोजित की गई।

बैठक में स्टेट मिशन डायरेक्टर, हाउसिंग फॉर ऑल, मध्यप्रदेश, श्री शिशिर गेमावत, राज्य स्तरीय बैंकर्स समिति के निदेशक श्री प्रमोद मिश्रा सहित विभिन्न बैंकों के वरिष्ठ अधिकारी भौतिक रूप से उपस्थित रहे, जबकि सभी जिलों के लीड डिस्ट्रिक्ट मैनेजर (LDM) वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के माध्यम से जुड़े।

बैठक में प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना (शहरी) 2.0 की इंटरेस्ट सब्सिडी स्कीम (ISS) तथा प्रधानमंत्री स्वनिधि योजना 2.0 की प्रगति की विस्तृत समीक्षा की गई। आयुक्त महोदय ने बैंकों को योजनाओं का व्यापक प्रचार-प्रसार सुनिश्चित करने, अधिक से अधिक पात्र हितग्राहियों से आवेदन प्राप्त करने तथा स्वीकृत प्रकरणों का शीघ्र निराकरण करने के निर्देश प्रदान किए।

उन्होंने सभी बैंकों से समन्वित एवं सक्रिय सहयोग के माध्यम से योजनाओं के लक्ष्यों की प्रभावी एवं शत-प्रतिशत प्राप्ति सुनिश्चित करने का आह्वान किया।

caption:
Honored to meet former Prime Minister Sri HD Deve Gowda Ji recently. 

Discussed critical debt restructuring issues for #karnataka-cooperative sugar factories .

He graciously wrote to PMO India Sri Narendra Modi Ji and the Home Minister Sri Amit Shah ji , urging central intervention policy reforms, kind support for a focused financial assistance programme for Karnataka’s cooperative sugar sector via the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC). The Government of Karnataka has submitted a comprehensive proposal to NCDC’s MD under the “Grant-in-Aid for Strengthening of Cooperative Sugar Mills (CSMS)” scheme and support.

Urgent Financial Revival Need: Karnataka’s cooperative sugar factories face severe economic distress and urgently need revival. These vital entities support lakhs of farmers, workers, and rural families as key community anchors.

Alignment with National Vision: This aligns with #AtmanirbharBharat, rural empowerment, and cooperative-led growth. Request special aid under #kalyanakarnataka Initiative for non-industrial zone factories.

Grateful for his leadership in championing Karnataka’s economic revival! 🇮🇳

caption:
The alleged 32nd Avenue ‘scam’ is a gut-punch to Gurugram’s carefully cultivated ‘Millennium City’ brand. For nearly a year now, a group of investors has been staging protests outside the 32nd Avenue office, alleging they were fleeced of crores in a Ponzi-style scam in the guise of prime real-estate investments. They’ve filed at least five FIRs, each with multiple complainants, written desperate letters to everyone from district officials to the PMO, created a dedicated Instagram page to document their claims, and staged dharnas, where they’ve shouted “Dhruv Sharma chor hai”. From retirees to doctors, well-laid financial and retirement plans have been unravelled by undeposited TDS, fake challans, and unpaid rental payments.

Like much that is marketed as glossy and global in India, the seamier side often surfaces eventually. It speaks to the shortcuts, hurried execution, and cut-and-paste hack job that often accompany many of India’s urban ambitions.

It’s been a sharp fall for Sharma, a resident of the exclusive Camellias, who came into the limelight in 2014 after co-founding GuestHouser, a holiday home-sharing platform that earned him a place in the Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia list in 2018. Forbes described him as a Boston University graduate who founded India’s “version of Airbnb”.

Read complete ground report by Sagrika Kissu: https://tinyurl.com/wtjxn82z

🚨 EXPOSED: राजपुर खुर्द में बड़े पैमाने पर अवैध प्लॉटिंग और पेड़ों की कटाई का स्कैम!

​राजपुर खुर्द के हरगोविंद एंक्लेव में प्रशासनिक मिलीभगत से एक बहुत बड़ा 'Land Scam' चल रहा है। यहाँ Agricultural Land को अवैध रूप से रिहायशी कॉलोनी में बदला जा रहा है।

​📋 ​लोकेशन: प्लॉट नं-50, खसरा नं-71(3-15), हरगोविंद एनक्लेव, नई दिल्ली-68 में 1 एकड़ भूमि पर लगे लगभग 50+ पूर्ण विकसित पेड़ों की अवैध कटाई करके अवैध रूप से प्लाटिंग की जा रही है।

इस अवैध धंधे में तीन विभागों की पूर्ण संलिप्तता स्पष्ट दिखाई देती है:
1. 👉 कानूनन कृषि भूमि के छोटे टुकड़ों (Platting) की रजिस्ट्री नहीं हो सकती, लेकिन यहाँ भू-माफिया के साथ मिलकर धड़ल्ले से रजिस्ट्री की जा रही है। यह सीधे तौर पर 'Stamp Duty' की चोरी और लैंड यूज़ का उल्लंघन है।
2. 👉 क्षेत्र के जिम्मेदार अधिकारी अपनी आंखें मूंदे बैठे हैं। आरोप है कि #MCD के #ExecutiveEngineer श्री संजीव मुगदल और #JuniorEngineer श्री अमन जैन भू-माफिया को संरक्षण दे रहे हैं। अवैध कॉलोनी बसती जा रही है और बुलडोजर खामोश हैं।
3. 👉 मेन रोड पर पेड़ कटते रहे और विभाग को खबर तक नहीं लगी? यह लापरवाही नहीं, बल्कि मौन सहमति है।

जब दिल्ली प्रदूषण से जूझ रही है, तो ऐसे में लगभग 50 से 60 पेड़ों की बलि देकर कंक्रीट का जंगल किसकी शह पर खड़ा हो रहा है? क्या चंद रुपयों के लिए दिल्ली का भविष्य बेचा जा रहा है?

हम मांग करते हैं कि माननीय #LtGovDelhi महोदय इस मामले की उच्च स्तरीय जांच के आदेश दें।
CMO Delhi Manjinder Singh Sirsa PMO India Delhi Police Amit Shah Ashok Vashisht Virendra Sachdeva Rekha Gupta Kapil Mishra Mcd Safaikaramchari BJP Delhi #mcd #ddastf

3. 👉 मेन रोड पर पेड़ कटते रहे और विभाग को खबर तक नहीं लगी? यह लापरवाही नहीं, बल्कि मौन सहमति है।

जब दिल्ली प्रदूषण से जूझ रही है, तो ऐसे में लगभग 50 से 60 पेड़ों की बलि देकर कंक्रीट का जंगल किसकी शह पर खड़ा हो रहा है? क्या चंद रुपयों के लिए दिल्ली का भविष्य बेचा जा रहा है?

In a major development, the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) has directed the Lok Sabha Secretariat that no parliamentary questions or discussions will be allowed on the PM CARES Fund, Prime Minister’s National Relief Fund (PMNRF), or the National Defence Fund (NDF). Citing Rules 41(2)(viii) and 41(2)(xvii) of the Lok Sabha's Rules of Procedure, the PMO states these funds are not primarily government concerns as they rely on voluntary public contributions, not the Consolidated Fund of India.  This comes amid ongoing debates over transparency and accountability for the PM CARES Fund. The communication was reportedly sent on January 30, as revealed by The Indian Express on February 9, 2026.  What does this mean for parliamentary oversight? GJEPC Asks to the Government for Union Budget 2026-27

Ask 4: Ad-Valorem Duty Drawback for Gold and Silver Jewellery

Why This Matters?
Fluctuation of gold and silver prices inversely affects the duty drawback given to exporters, which is fixed.

Exporters are only recovering 75–80% of actual duty paid, which leads to losses.

How it Helps?
A value-based drawback system will ensure refunds move in line with metal prices.

This provides fair compensation, helping exporters maintain margins and export growth.

PMO India Nirmala Sitharaman Department of Commerce, GoI

caption:
⚛️🇮🇳 Kudankulam Stands Unshaken — India’s Nuclear Resolve Is Stronger Than Geopolitics 🔥🌍

In a world where global equations shift overnight, one truth is becoming unmistakably clear:

India’s nuclear journey is unstoppable.

Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant — India’s largest — is moving ahead with precision, stability, and absolute confidence, untouched by the turbulence of international politics or temporary diplomatic winds.

🚀 What’s on the horizon? Timelines that speak of discipline and intent:

🔸 Units 3 & 4 → Targeted for completion by 2026–27

🔸 Units 5 & 6 → On track for 2030

No delays. No uncertainty. No external disruption.

This is what strategic clarity looks like.

🔍 Why this matters globally

Kudankulam is not merely a project — it is a living demonstration of India’s ability to execute mega nuclear infrastructure under pressure, across decades, and through changing geopolitical landscapes.

A quick reality check:

• Conceived in 1988

• Construction began 2002

• First unit operational 2014

• Two units delivering power reliably within the last decade

Through political transitions, global realignments, and evolving technology partnerships, Kudankulam has remained the gold standard of India’s nuclear resilience.

🌏 The world should pay attention

At a time when nations are struggling with energy security, India is building certainty.

When others debate timelines, India meets them.

When geopolitics shifts, India stays the course.

This is more than infrastructure — it is national confidence engineered in concrete and steel.

💬 Your turn

What lesson does Kudankulam send to the global nuclear community?

👇 Share your perspective.

author.name: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology - IITM, Pune

caption:
India Honours a Lifetime of Distinguished Contributions to the understanding and prediction of the Indian Monsoon system and in Physical Oceanography

Dr. A. Suryachandra Rao, Director, IITM. was conferred the Dr. H. N. Siddique Memorial Lecture & Gold Medal — one of the most prestigious honours of the Indian Geophysical Union — in recognition of his distinguished and sustained contributions to physical oceanography, coupled ocean–atmosphere dynamics, and the prediction of the Indian Summer Monsoon; during the 62nd Annual Convention of the Indian Geophysical Union (IGU) held at INCOIS, Hyderabad (6–8 November 2025) on the theme
“Geosciences for Blue Economy – Potential of the Indian Ocean,”

The award was presented by Dr. M. Ravichandran, Secretary, Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), during the Fourth Triennial Congress of Federation of Indian Geosciences Association 2025 (FIGA 2025) scientific conference.

The convention brought together leading scientists and professionals from across geosciences, marine sciences, and ocean technology, underscoring the pivotal role of geosciences in advancing the Blue Economy and Indian Ocean research.

#IGU #FIGA25 #INCOIS #MoES #Oceanography #MonsoonResearch #BlueEconomy #IndianOcean #Geosciences #IndianScience   Surya Anguluri

caption:
De Ambassade van India in Suriname organiseerde met trots een receptie ter gelegenheid van de 77e Dag van de Republiek India, die samenvalt met het gouden jubileum van de diplomatieke betrekkingen tussen India en Suriname.
De receptie werd geëerd door de aanwezigheid van H.E. Drs. Jennifer Geerling-Simons, president van Suriname, als eregast, samen met ministers waaronder Z.E. Melvin Bouva, en ook parlementariërs, hoge ambtenaren, diplomaten, media en prominente leden van de Indiase diaspora.
In haar toespraak sprak de eregast haar oprechte felicitaties uit aan India en benadrukte zij de blijvende band tussen de twee landen, gebaseerd op wederzijds respect, solidariteit en gedeelde ontwikkelingsdoelen.
Ambassadeur Subhash Gupta benadrukte India’s voortdurende sociaal-economische transformatie richting Viksit Bharat 2047, de uitbreiding van bilaterale samenwerking, succesvolle ontwikkelingsprojecten en de sterke mensen-tot-mensenbanden die via de diaspora zijn opgebouwd.
De avond werd gevuld met culturele optredens, waaronder de gezamenlijke voordracht van #VandeMataram en authentieke Indiase gerechten, die de rijke tradities en de vriendschap tussen India en Suriname symboliseren.
***
The Embassy of India hosted a National Reception marking the 77th Republic Day of India, coinciding with the Golden Jubilee of diplomatic relations between India and Suriname.

Honored by the presence of H.E. Dr. Jennifer Geerling-Simons, President of Suriname, as Chief Guest, along with Cabinet Ministers including H.E. Melvin Bouva, parliamentarians, senior officials, diplomats, media, and distinguished members of the Indian diaspora.

In her address, the Chief Guest conveyed heartfelt congratulations to India and highlighted the enduring bond between our two nations built on mutual respect, solidarity, and shared development goals.

Ambassador Subhash Gupta emphasized India’s ongoing socio-economic transformation towards Viksit Bharat 2047, expanding bilateral cooperation, successful development partnership projects, and the strong people-to-people connections nurtured through diaspora links 

The evening showcased vibrant cultural performances including mass recitation of #vandematram and authentic Indian cuisine, symbolizing the rich traditions and friendship between India and Suriname.

Veterans later claimed that it crippled India’s human intelligence network across the western border for years. What was meant as a peace gesture became a strategic misstep—an incident still discussed in hushed tones in intelligence circles. Gujral’s decision remains a dramatic reminder of how one political move can reshape the unseen world of spies, shadows, and national security forever.

#BiharHaiTaiyar
📢उद्योग और रोजगार के क्षेत्र में रफ्तार पकड़ता बिहार!
#buildandbelieveinbihar 

Amnesty Policy–2025 and Exit Policy–2025 Gain Momentum

Under the leadership of Hon’ble Chief Minister Shri Nitish Kumar, the #BIADA is unlocking industrial potential by reviving closed and disputed units and converting idle land into investment-ready assets across Bihar.
A review meeting was held under the chairmanship of Shri Kundan Kumar, Secretary, Industries cum CMD, BIADA, to discuss in detail the progress of both policies. After reviewing the applications, several important decisions were taken. The effective implementation of these two policies is expected to bring wide and positive changes to the state’s industrial landscape.                                                                               
Nearly 100 industrial cases have been resolved, unlocking previously stalled assets. Around 100 acres of land have been opened up for new investors.
An estimated ₹600–800 crore in fresh industrial investment has been facilitated.
The initiative is accelerating industrial growth and generating large-scale employment opportunities.

Eligible units can avail this one-time opportunity until March 31, 2026.
Opening opportunities for investors and driving Bihar’s industrial growth forward.

#IndustrialGrowth #EaseOfDoingBusiness #bihar

caption:
Used oil from frying pans is being used to flying planes!

Yet another significant milestone in meeting India’s SAF blending mandate of achieving 1% blending by 2027, 2% by 2028 and 5% by 2030. This is a positive step towards our cleaner, greener and self-reliant energy future under the dynamic and decisive leadership of PM Sh Narendra Modi Ji.

Visakh Refinery of HPCL has inaugurated the demonstration plant of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) production through co-processing of Used Cooking Oil (UCO) in its Full Conversion Hydrocracker Unit leveraging the existing refinery assets. 

As per HPCL’s roadmap, post CORSIA certification, Visakh Refinery will produce ~10 TMT per annum of SAF from January 2027, supporting our nation's commitment to decarbonising aviation and promoting a circular, waste-to-wealth economy. 

This pioneering initiative strengthens our countries energy #Aatmanirbharta, aligns with global CORSIA standards, and reinforces the nation’s Net-Zero targets.

PMO India Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban
Press Information Bureau - PIB,  Government of India
 
#SustainableAviationFuel #SAF #EnergyTransition #AtmanirbharBharat #NetZero #HPCL

caption:
What if you could buy Philippine government assets legally, transparently, and at scale? In this video, I take you inside an exclusive, invite-only conference hosted by the Privatization and Management Office (PMO), where thousands of government properties are being prepared for sale to the private sector.

I’ll show you why distressed assets often hold the biggest upside, how PMO, PCGG, LANDBANK, and NDC actually sell their inventory, and what real investors need to know about risk, settlers, legal issues, pricing, and process. We also talk about 4% installment rates, no capital gains tax on PMO sales, and why there may be a coming “fire sale” as agencies are pushed to dispose their ROPA and legacy assets.

In this video we cover:
Who the PMO is and how government assets are privatized
What types of properties are in the current portfolio (Makati, Caloocan, Cavite and more)
How auctions, unsolicited offers and negotiated sales really work
How agencies handle informal settlers, tax issues and title problems
Why awareness is still low (and why that means less competition)
How PCGG, LANDBANK and NDC also hold investable assets
Where the real upside is for serious investors and developers

This video is part of the Breaking Ground Podcast ecosystem, where we help Filipinos invest smarter through real conversations with government, banks, and industry leaders.

If you want a step-by-step breakdown of how to actually buy one of these properties, comment “PMO” and I’ll consider documenting a full acquisition journey in a future episode.

⚛️🇮🇳 INDIA JUST DROPPED A GAME-CHANGER: THE TRUE COST OF OUR SMR FUTURE ⚡🌍

This is the moment the world realizes India is not just participating in the SMR race — we’re leading it.

A bold disclosure has electrified the nuclear community:

👉 The demonstration cost of the BSMR-200 is tentatively ₹27 Cr/MWe.

And here’s the shockwave — this cost will fall sharply once the first-of-a-kind unit proves itself, thanks to design standardisation and economies of scale.

For a technology that promises rapid decarbonization, industrial competitiveness, and energy sovereignty, this is a landmark milestone.

🔥 What India is building under the Nuclear Energy Mission is unprecedented

The Government of India has already provisioned dedicated funds for:

🔬 Research, design & development of SMRs

🏗️ Construction of lead units at DAE sites

⚡ Full-scale deployment by 2033

This is not a concept. This is a construction plan.

🇮🇳⚛️ BARC’s SMR Lineup Is Now Officially in Motion

220 MWe BSMR-200 → Lead unit at Tarapur, Maharashtra

55 MWe SMR-55 → Lead unit also at Tarapur

≤5 MWth High-Temperature Gas-Cooled Reactor → For hydrogen, at BARC Vizag, Andhra Pradesh

These aren’t just reactors.

They are India’s signature on the global nuclear map.

🌏 Why the world should pay attention

Because India is demonstrating a model every nation wants:

Affordable SMRs

Fast build timelines

Modular deployment for industries

Clean hydrogen production

Repurposing fossil assets instead of abandoning them

This is how nations rewrite their energy destiny.

💬 Your thoughts?

Is India setting the benchmark for SMR economics and deployment strategy?

Repost, comment, and let’s ignite the global nuclear conversation. ⚛️🔥

PMO India Dr Jitendra Singh Dr V K Saraswat

caption:
🚀 From Atoms to Aspirations: A New Chapter Begins at Kalpakkam 🇮🇳⚛️

Leadership in nuclear science isn’t just about titles — it’s about trust, continuity, and vision across generations.

Today, India’s strategic nuclear ecosystem turns a decisive page as Shri Sreekumar G Pillai assumes charge as Director, Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR), Kalpakkam, from 1 January 2026. 🌏✨

This is not merely a leadership transition.

It is a statement of intent.

🔹 Three and a half decades at BARC

🔹 Deep mastery of the back-end fuel cycle

🔹 Hands-on leadership in reprocessing, waste management & safeguards

🔹 Proven delivery of multi-crore, high-risk, high-precision nuclear projects

From the Plutonium Plant at Trombay to steering strategic recycle facilities critical for India’s second-stage nuclear programme, Shri Pillai’s journey reflects what nuclear leadership truly demands: technical depth, institutional memory, and quiet resilience.

At a time when the world is rediscovering nuclear energy — for climate stability, energy security, and strategic autonomy — IGCAR sits at the heart of India’s fast reactor and closed fuel cycle ambitions. 🌍⚡

Under his stewardship, the focus sharpens on:

• Advanced reactor systems

• Safe, safeguarded fuel recycling

• Cost-discipline with uncompromising safety

• Translating decades of R&D into deployable national assets

For global nuclear professionals, policymakers, and CEOs watching India closely — this appointment signals continuity with competence, not disruption with rhetoric.

For young scientists, it sends a powerful message:

👉 Excellence, patience, and integrity still shape the top of India’s nuclear pyramid.

As one era concludes and another begins, Kalpakkam stands ready — not just to lead India’s nuclear future, but to inspire global confidence in it.

💬 What do you believe will define the next decade of advanced nuclear research in India?

Let’s discuss.

PMO India Dr Jitendra Singh Dr V K Saraswat

#NuclearLeadership #IGCAR #IndiaNuclear #FuelCycle #AtomicEnergy #ScienceLeadership #EnergySecurity #AdvancedReactors #ProudlyIndian

caption:
🇮🇳⚛️ When the Oldest Nuclear Reactor Stands Up Strong Again — India Shows the World What Resilience Looks Like ⚛️🇮🇳

Tarapur-1 is back. And it’s more powerful than ever.

Today is not just another milestone.

It is a statement — of India’s engineering courage, scientific depth, and nuclear maturity.

🔥 TAPS-1 Begins Its Second Innings — A Historic Moment for India & the World

Commissioned in 1969, Tarapur-1 has now been synchronised back to the National Grid after a meticulous, multi-year refurbishment and life extension.

A reactor that began its journey before the Moon Landing…

…today rises again with:

🔹 Upgraded safety systems

🔹 Modernised equipment

🔹 Enhanced reliability

🔹 Renewed operational life

🔹 NPCIL’s uncompromising focus on safety and excellence

This is not revival.

This is renaissance.

🇮🇳 Why this matters — to India, and to global nuclear leaders

✔ Demonstrates India’s capability to extend reactor life with world-class engineering

✔ Proves our self-reliance in nuclear refurbishment — a strategic skill few nations possess

✔ Strengthens long-term clean, stable, dispatchable energy security

✔ Showcases sustainable utilisation of existing assets

✔ Reinforces India’s position as a credible nuclear powerhouse heading toward 100 GWe by 2047

When the world debates ageing fleets…

India turns an ageing reactor into a fresh asset.

That is innovation.

That is confidence.

That is India.

🙏 Congratulations Team TAPS-1&2. Congratulations NPCIL. Congratulations India.

This “oldest running reactor” has given the world a new lesson:

Age doesn’t limit excellence — vision does.

💬 What’s your biggest takeaway from TAPS-1’s second innings?

Share your thoughts — let’s celebrate India’s engineering triumph together.

PMO India Dr Jitendra Singh Dr V K Saraswat

caption:
🇮🇳Pre-Summit for AI Impact Summit 2026! 🇮🇳

On 21st January 2026, Embassy of India in Jakarta in collaboration with MSC (MicroSave Consulting), IndCham (the India Indonesia Chamber of Commerce), India’s Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) under the NITI Aayog  convened the official Pre-Summit Event of the AI Impact Summit 2026, titled “People, Planet, Progress: The India–Indonesia Dialogue on Inclusive AI”.

The event brought together several stakeholders, including senior government officials, industry leaders, global development partners, and technology experts from both nations, to deepen cooperation on responsible, human-centric, and ethically governed artificial intelligence systems.

During the event H.E. Mr Nezar Patria, Vice Minister of Communication and Digital Affairs (KOMDIGI); Ambassador of India to Indonesia; President Director & CEO of Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, Mr. Vikram Sinha; Programme Director and Mission Director at the Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP), Ms. Anna Roy; and many other distinguished speakers presented their views on the role of AI to serve the public interest and drive equitable growth.
In his opening remarks, Ambassador emphasized that AI plays a strategic role in advancing social good, including improving public services, expanding financial inclusion, and strengthening needs-based social protection.

Indonesia is one of the co-chair country for the working group ‘ AI for Economic Growth and Social Good’ for the event and is working closely with India. This dialogue will lay the foundation for future discussions at the global summit in New Delhi on 19-20 February 2026, under the aegis of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. 

For more details, click the press release link 👉  : https://www.indianembassyjakarta.gov.in/users/assets/pdf/press/press__5631146.pdf
